chatgptPrompt: Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area. Subject: a Moon filling most of the frame over a thin beach, cracks of shadow. Text: "Too close" in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), white with one teal word (#4FE3C6). Palette: indigo night (#0B0F2A), teal glow. Avoid arrows, circles, faces, logos, watermarks, anything that looks like a real NASA photo. It must read as a painted illustration. Scientific accuracy: this is a thought experiment, the real Moon is not coming closer.
